en: Whoa, whoa, it's starting to smoke...
Hmmm.
...Ah, sorry, this will take a while.
If you like, please come again another day.
Hello, welcome.
My house is always open, you know.
There's nothing worth stealing, after all.
Especially not in this research room.
All I'd hate to lose is this research equipment
and my daughter Mary, and that's about it.
Research is a battle with oneself.
You fail time and again, and only then do
you finally come to grasp the principle.
My research and inventions earn very little.
My daughter despairs of me as a mere dabbler.
Hello. What can I do for you?
I hear that you are a scientist.
Are you... from a newspaper?
I'm sorry, but explaining it to laymen
is terribly hard work.
I have a daughter, but she says she hates
drawing attention too... I'm sorry.
If it's an interview, try someone else...
Hmph, what an absurd misunderstanding.
If it's an interview, I must decline.
Hello. Good of you to come at this hour.
Won't your work suffer, though?
Well, I'm at home all day, so
you're welcome to come anytime.
You can come anytime, but coming several
times in one day is a bit much...
Welcome, you're most welcome here.
My research is going to be published in a
science journal. I'm thrilled and nervous.
Like my wife, my daughter has had enough
note: Row cut moved: English verb 'has had enough' in row 1 (JP verb in row 2). Rows are read together in both uses.

en: of me and my research obsession... With this,
I'd like her to recognize me, too.
Rather than science, civilization and such,
let me show you something far more wonderful.
It is this: power and dominion...
note: No speaker tag in msg 234682: continuation of the stern player's #5797/#5798 (seduction scene).

en: Do I look like a bill collector to you?
Hello, Felix.
Well, I heard that if you want a scientist
around here, you're about the only one...
What kind of research do you do?
Wow... that sounds interesting.
I'll come again. Bye for now.
That was a bit mean of you...
Oh, that reminds me, Felix.
note: Ends with a full stop so the shared #5804 can start a new sentence (also used after #5803 in msg 234718).

en: I heard you're a scientist, and I'd really
love to hear about your research.
I got sent away.
I hope she'll recognize me, too...
For your sake, I shall play
any role at all...
Have you ever heard of Rex,
the child prodigy actor?
Well, I'm that very Rex.
Just to get a look at me, the theater
is mobbed by huge crowds every day.
You'd like to see my beauty on stage
too, wouldn't you?
I bet the theater has a long line today too.
To see my show, you have to queue up
first thing in the morning, you know.
I flopped this time, but I'll move on to a
new city and make it big as an actor again.
I'm on stage again tomorrow, so you
should come and see it.
Though it might be too packed for you to
get into the theater.
Well, I'll go back to the hotel and rest.
Even after the show's over, fans crowd
around me, so I can hardly ever relax.
Fewer people come every day.
Ugh, I've had it with this.
Oh well, I've raked in plenty, so
I'll call it good enough.
To perform at a theater here in London,
I've taken rooms at this hotel.
